messages.author: 2502c952822e4f47
messages.subject: QTL for multiple quantitative traits
parts:
Dear R/qtl users,

I am trying to identify qtl for multiple traits in a doubled haploid population. I am able to analyze one trait at a time.

Is there a way to tell R/qtl to analyze all the traits one by one or simultaneously ?

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] QTL for multiple quantitative traits
parts:
For multiple-QTL analyses, traits are analyzed individually. Specify them with the argument pheno.col.

karl
